findings.label: Templates not migrated
findings.description: All feature and shared component templates (home, auth, post-form, post-detail, dashboard, admin, about, donation-modal, post-card, alert-status-badge, reviews) contain hardcoded French text with zero | translate pipe calls. TranslateModule was added to each component's TypeScript imports array but no HTML template was updated. Each template must replace hardcoded strings with {{ 'NAMESPACE.KEY' | translate }} bindings.

findings.label: POST_FORM namespace absent
findings.description: The review spec requires a POST_FORM namespace. It does not exist in either JSON file — post-form keys live under POST. Either rename/split the namespace or document that POST covers both post-form and post-detail concerns.

findings.label: Absolute HttpLoader path risks non-root deployments
findings.description: TranslateHttpLoader(http, '/i18n/', '.json') uses an absolute URL. If the app is deployed under a sub-path the loader will 404. Use a relative path or APP_BASE_HREF-aware path.

findings.label: Language switcher tooltip hardcoded
findings.description: The [title] attribute on the desktop language button uses a hardcoded ternary instead of 'NAV.LANG_SWITCH' | translate. The key exists in both JSON files; the binding should use the pipe.
